newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system repurchases.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system repurchases.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system via overnight system repurchases on Wednesday, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
Federal funds were trading at 5-1/8 percent, below the Fed's target for the rate, at the time of the operation.
Analysts had said that the Fed might add temporary reserves to the banking system, but had generally thought that th Fed had the leeway to take no action.
